s1-victim.desc: a night cook in a stained apron

s1-victim-b.desc: an older resident with a quilted bag

s1-mugger.desc: a thin man in a green scarf

red-herring-night-courier.desc: a night courier with a shoulder bag

go-between-courier.desc: a delivery runner in a gray jacket

extra:partner.desc: a resident in a night robe

steps.line: {s1-victim} hurries into the lift hall with empty hands, apron still on.
{s1-victim} points {night-stakeout-officer} at the empty floor of lift 2.
{s1-victim} tells {night-stakeout-officer} {s1-victim.his} takeaway bag was snatched in lift 2 a few minutes ago.
{night-stakeout-officer} runs a handheld scan along the seams of the lift door.
{night-stakeout-officer} stands at the lift hall corner, a paper cup on the ledge, watching the lifts.
{rookie-officer} reads the lobby log aloud: "03:40, lift 2. 03:12, lift 2. 03:05, lift 2."
{s1-lobby-guard} leaves the lobby desk empty and walks off down the back corridor.
{s1-lobby-guard} walks back to the lobby desk eight minutes later and sits down.
{red-herring-night-courier} knocks at the lift hall door and waits, a paper bag in hand.
{rookie-officer} calls out, and {red-herring-night-courier} bolts for the stairs with the bag.
{rookie-officer} runs after {red-herring-night-courier} toward the stair door.
{night-stakeout-officer} puts a hand on {rookie-officer}'s arm and holds {rookie-officer.him} at the door.
{s1-victim-b} tells {rookie-officer} the man wore a green scarf and held {s1-victim-b.his} bag in his left hand.
{s1-victim-b} points at the lobby screen beside the lift doors.
{rookie-officer} reads the lobby screen still: a figure in a green scarf, stamped "03:40."
{s1-mugger} waits outside the food counter, green scarf pulled up, hands in {s1-mugger.his} pockets.
{go-between-courier} hands {s1-mugger} a folded paper bag without a word.
{s1-mugger} carries the paper bag in {s1-mugger.his} left hand into the lift hall.
{red-herring-night-courier} knocks at tenement door 3B before dawn and waits, bag in hand.
{extra:partner} opens door 3B and hugs {red-herring-night-courier} in the doorway.
{red-herring-night-courier} lifts flowers and a loaf of bread out of the bag at the door.
{rookie-officer} kneels in lift 2 and runs a light along the gap at the floor edge.
{rookie-officer} tweezes a torn paper scrap with printed columns out of the gap.
{rookie-officer} reads the scrap aloud: "RT," then a column of numbers.
{night-stakeout-officer} stands at the lift hall corner again, the paper cup on the same ledge.
{s1-mugger}, green scarf up, bumps {extra:resident} at lift 2 and takes the takeaway bag in {s1-mugger.his} left hand.
{s1-mugger} runs for the stair door, not the lifts, the bag swinging.
{night-stakeout-officer} steps out at the stair door and pins {s1-mugger} to the wall.
{rookie-officer} pulls a folded paper slip from {s1-mugger}'s left sleeve.
{rookie-officer} unfolds the slip: printed columns of stops and a payday at the bottom.
{s1-mugger} sits at the interview table, the green scarf in {s1-mugger.his} lap.
{s1-mugger} tells {rookie-officer} a courier paid {s1-mugger.him} ten credits a run and handed over the slip each Thursday.
{rookie-officer} lifts a second takeaway bag out of the property box.
{rookie-officer} hands the folded slip to {desk-sergeant} for the case file.
Comm, one side: "I said stew. Eat the stew."
{night-stakeout-officer} passes the lobby desk and gives {s1-lobby-guard} a small wave.
{s1-lobby-guard} stays seated at the lobby desk, comm at {s1-lobby-guard.his} ear, through the usual eight minutes away.
{night-stakeout-officer} watches the lift hall from the corner, cup on the ledge, and no bags are taken.
{rookie-officer} hands {s1-victim-b} {s1-victim-b.his} quilted bag back at the lift doors.
{rookie-officer} reads the lobby log aloud: "Closed. No new entries."
